entity.name: Manav Arya Singh
entity.description: Independent developer. I build and maintain designlang, an MIT-licensed tool that reads the design system of any live website and hands it to AI coding agents as real design tokens.

projects.name: designlang
projects.description: designlang reads any live website's design system in a real browser and writes it as files AI coding tools can use: W3C DTCG design tokens, a Tailwind config, CSS variables, a shadcn/ui theme, Figma variables, and a DESIGN.md that tells Claude Code, Cursor or Windsurf how a brand actually looks. A stdio MCP server exposes the same tokens to those editors as tools, and a design score measures how generic a page looks. The command is `npx designlang <url>`: free, MIT licensed, no account and no API key.
